decision_ref: user request 2026-09-16: derive tuning values from the two behaviour analyses (stairs climb section 8, rough side-step section 9) and build the package. Server execution is still not released; this is a local package.

external_reference.after_change_vs_go2_rough: two terms differ: feet_air_time (0.2 vs 0.01, inherited from G-A033) and lin_vel_z_l2 (-1.0 vs -2.0, this run)
external_reference.departure_reason: Measured on G-A033's own evaluation trajectories (analysis 8-2, CLIMB_REWARD.csv): on a 10cm climb the vertical-velocity penalty takes 34% of the tracking gain over stalling. It scales with step height squared, so at 15cm it is estimated at 76%. The Isaac Lab value is a comparison anchor, not proof of an optimum (MASTER 1-b).
external_reference.literature: R-Sci-4 (Hwangbo 2019): penalties that the objective motion must pay are the stall-exploit risk; R-Sci-1 Table 2 carries -v_z^2 as a form only (weights not transferred)
external_reference.r6: reward weight only; curriculum, terrain, DR, commands untouched

value_derivation.measured_10cm_share: (0.124-0.021)/(0.985-0.679) = 34% of the climb's tracking gain is paid back as lin_vel_z_l2
value_derivation.estimated_15cm_share: vz scales with step height at the same forward speed, so the penalty scales with (15/10)^2 = 2.25: 0.103*2.25/0.306 = 76%
value_derivation.rule: choose the weight that brings the 15cm share back to the share G-A033 already climbs 10cm stairs with: 76% * (w/2) ~= 34%  ->  w ~= 0.9, rounded to 1.0 (share 38%)
value_derivation.not_claimed: The share is a reward-arithmetic quantity on two measurable terms. It does not predict how many robots will climb. ang_vel_xy, joint penalties and termination risk are not in the measurement.

rejected_alternatives.ang_vel_xy_l2: not relaxed: it penalises roll as well as pitch, and the G3 min-case rough_lateral ends in sideways roll-over (analysis section 9, LATERAL_BEHAVIOR.csv tilt cos -0.973)
rejected_alternatives.track_lin_vel_xy_exp: held: rough_lateral terminations rose at both track steps, 31 -> 48 -> 58 (analysis 9-1)
rejected_alternatives.feet_air_time: held at 0.2: lowering it cut slope progress on the A017 base (A031), raising it collapsed Pilot (A015) (analysis 8-1b)
rejected_alternatives.penalty_strengthening: no strengthened penalty on a walking base has walked (analysis 8-1b)

evaluation.checkpoint_rule: same training length and seed as G-A033, so the candidate is read at the checkpoint G-A033 was read at (900 of 1000). finalize's reward pick is kept as training/model_best_by_reward.pt and is not evaluated.

sentinel_tolerance.note: same as G-A035, G-A033 and G-A030. Evaluation replay measured delta 0.0000 (A017 sentinel, 6 days apart), so exceeding it means remeasure the baseline, not a verdict on the candidate

detectability.basis: Headroom, not an estimate: G5 loses 10.46/70 and G3 loses 9.77/70 on G-A033 (SCENARIO_SCORES.csv). Headroom is a necessary condition only.
detectability.expected_gain_basis: Not estimated. lin_vel_z_l2 has never been moved on a walking base (MASTER 1-a G-D116), so there is no point to extrapolate from.
detectability.seed_noise: Every training run used seed 42. A single change moved 10cm two-step climbs 19 -> 2 -> 43 of 96, and whether that was the lever or the seed cannot be told. One run cannot separate an effect smaller than that spread.
detectability.superseded_by: inference (2026-09-17): the point-gain waiver rule was replaced by the fact-based inference chain

inference.rule: fact-based inference chain (2026-09-17 user instruction; MASTER section 5, AGENTS 4-9); a point-gain estimate is not required
inference.role: Isaac Lab v2.3.1 lin_vel_z_l2: square of the base z velocity in the body frame (isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py:76). No sign: bouncing, dropping and stepping up are penalised alike (GO2_TUNING_BASE_DATA.md section 0-1).

rows.reads: G-A033 robots that climbed 10cm: tracking rate 0.985, vertical penalty rate -0.124
robots stalled before the 15cm stairs pay -0.021: climbing costs more vertical penalty than stalling
at -1.0: walk +0.0242, climb +0.0515, sway -0.0940, push -0.0771 (partial margins; direction only)
walking runs only ever carried -2; -1.0 is outside every observed walking value

contradicting.key: S5 오르기 수직 벌점 몫 대 15cm 오르기
contradicting.reads: across Pilot-01, A017 and G-A033 a smaller vertical-penalty share did not go with more 15cm climbing, the opposite of this candidate's derivation
the last trade-term change moved the 10cm climb far beyond its forecast size (90 -> 5 robots climbing a step); the partial-margin size cannot be trusted for this term either

inference.singularity: lin_vel_z_l2 and ang_vel_xy_l2 are the two trade terms: the climbing state carries larger values, the pre-fall state on a side-step or push carries larger values too (FORECAST 5-1, SEED_SENSITIVITY 4). Weakening one moves the balance toward climbing and away from sway and push.

walk.basis: walk margin +0.0242 (PROBES.csv), stays in the walking zone

climb.basis: partial margin +0.0515; size unknown after G-A038

sway.basis: partial margin -0.0940, sign agrees on 3 policies

push.basis: partial margin -0.0771, sign agrees on 2 policies

inference.falsified_if: 15cm climbed-at-least-one-step stays at or below G-A033's 4 (3 seeds) and 10cm two-step climbing does not rise above 43: weakening the vertical penalty does not free the climb.
inference.seed_limit: Every training run used seed 42 and no seed replicate exists, so a result supports or refutes the chain; it does not fix a lever effect (reports/GO2_SEED_SENSITIVITY.md section 5).
inference.status_reason: The derivation (a smaller vertical-penalty share climbs more) runs opposite to S5, and -1.0 is outside the observed walking values. Upload stays on hold (GO2_NOW.md).

preregistered.source: analysis section 8-3b (all axes kept while stairs rise) on the criteria of GO2_BASIC_MOTION_TUNING_PLAN_20260915.md section 6-1, limits measured as in G-A035 section 15-4
preregistered.threshold_basis: Measured, not intended. tools/go2_eval_resolution.py (reports/runs/BASELINE_MARGIN.csv delta_resample_sd) gave per-scenario weighted-score standard deviations of G3 1.01823, G4 0.49816, G6 0.43098, G2 0.28229, G7 0.20179, G5 0.02802, G1 0.00000 (/70) and a total-difference sd of 1.26443/70. Each non-flat scenario may lose at most twice its own sd (max_scenario_weighted_loss_70_by_scenario); flat G1/G2 use max_flat_scenario_proxy_drop 2x0.28229/10.5 = 0.054 and max_flat_case_survival_drop 2 robots of 32. max_scenario_weighted_loss_70 keeps G-A035's uniform 2.04 as the fallback for any scenario not listed. min_total_points_delta is the 2-sigma detection limit 2.53. min_target_mean_proxy_delta 0.05 and min_target_groups_improved 2 are section 6-1's values, unchanged.

why: Goal: climb stairs while every other axis stays high (analysis 8-3b). G-A033 loses 10.46/70 on G5 and 9.77/70 on G3.
G5: no policy has climbed two 15cm steps. Robots walk to the first riser and stop level (analysis 2-3).
Stopping keeps about 47% of the flat-walking reward rate (CLIMB_REWARD.csv).
On a 10cm climb G-A033 pays back 34% of the tracking gain as lin_vel_z_l2; at 15cm this is estimated at 76%.
Walking itself started only when lin_vel_z and ang_vel_xy were relaxed together to the Isaac Lab values (analysis 8-1b).
G3: rough_lateral ends in sideways roll-over, and ang_vel_xy is the roll-rate penalty, so it stays at -0.05 (analysis 9).
track stays at 1.5: roll-over terminations rose 31 -> 48 -> 58 over the two track steps.
An earlier note (MASTER line on slope stalls) excluded lin_vel_z by comparing its whole-episode size with the stall loss.
This run uses a different quantity: the share of the climb's own tracking gain, measured per robot.
Risks pre-registered: body bounce on flat ground (G1/G2 guards), push recovery (G6 limit 0.86196/70), roll-over on rough side-steps (G3 limit and target group).

notes.comparison_validity: Same seed 42, 4096 envs, 1000 iterations, evaluator and registry SHA as the stored G-A033 arm, evaluated at the same checkpoint iteration. The only difference is lin_vel_z_l2.
notes.not_claimed: No score gain is promised. One training seed cannot separate the lever from seed luck.
